info.title: LettBestilt API
info.description:
The LettBestilt API lets you build restaurant websites on top of LettBestilt: menus, orders, payments, order tracking, table reservations, coupons and webhooks. All amounts are integers in øre (1 NOK = 100 øre). Timestamps are ISO 8601 in UTC. The restaurant is identified by its `slug` (the `slug` query parameter). Every response includes `X-Request-Id`; error envelopes include `error.requestId`.

New restaurant keys look like `lbs_live_<id>_<secret>` or `lbs_test_<id>_<secret>`; older `lbs_<secret>` keys are still accepted. Partner keys (`lbp_live_…`/`lbp_test_…`) belong to the partner and only work against `/api/v1/partner`; the restaurant endpoints reject them with `401`. Test keys can reach sandbox restaurants before go-live. Inactive sandbox restaurants are available, while other inactive restaurants return `404`. The partner API under `/api/v1/partner` (tag Partner) is server to server only: the partner key (`lbp_…`) goes in `Authorization`, plus the restaurant key in `X-LettBestilt-Restaurant-Key` for calls about one restaurant.

tags.name: Partner
tags.description: The LettBestilt Partner API (`/api/v1/partner`). The partner key (`lbp_…`) alone lists and creates restaurants; everything about one existing restaurant also needs that restaurant's own key in `X-LettBestilt-Restaurant-Key`. Server to server only. Limits: 120 requests per minute per partner key and 600 per minute per partner across all its keys (429 `RATE_LIMITED`). JSON request bodies are limited to 1 MB; a larger body gives 413 `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE`.

RequestId.description: Unique identifier for this response. The value is also present as error.requestId on errors.

BearerApiKey.description: Either this or a trusted browser origin. The restaurant's API key (`lbs_live_…` or `lbs_test_…`), sent as `Authorization: Bearer lbs_…` and created for the restaurant in LettBestilt Partner. Required when the request does not come from a trusted browser origin. Use it from your server only, never in browser code. A partner key (`lbp_…`) only works against `/api/v1/partner` and is rejected here with `401 UNAUTHORIZED`. A key can have an expiry date; an expired key returns `401 KEY_EXPIRED`. A key can also be limited to some scopes; an endpoint outside them returns `403 INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE` with the required scope in `error.details.requiredScope`.

BrowserOrigin.name: Origin
BrowserOrigin.description: Either this or an API key. No key is needed when the request's `Origin` header is trusted for this restaurant's slug: the LettBestilt app itself, `https://{slug}.lettbestilt.no`, a verified domain of the restaurant, or a partner origin LettBestilt has bound to the restaurant. Browsers set `Origin` themselves; it is not something you configure, but an API key in a header is the closest OpenAPI description of the mechanism. Not accepted by `GET /api/v1/site-gate`, which requires an API key.

PartnerApiKey.description: The partner key (`lbp_test_…` or `lbp_live_…`), sent as `Authorization: Bearer lbp_…` and created in LettBestilt Partner under **Partner key**. It belongs to the whole partner, not to a restaurant, and only works against `/api/v1/partner`. Server to server only: a request with an `Origin` header is rejected with `403 FORBIDDEN`, and the key must never be in a browser. A TEST key sees and creates only sandboxes; LIVE keys work once LettBestilt Partner is open. A suspended or archived partner, a revoked key and a restaurant key (`lbs_…`) here give `401 UNAUTHORIZED`; an expired key gives `401 KEY_EXPIRED`.

RestaurantKeyHeader.name: X-LettBestilt-Restaurant-Key
RestaurantKeyHeader.description: The restaurant's own key (`lbs_test_…` or `lbs_live_…`) for calls about one restaurant in the partner API, sent together with the partner key. The key must have full access (scope `*`, otherwise `403 INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE`), belong to a restaurant the partner owns and be in the same environment as the partner key. A restaurant that does not exist, belongs to another partner or does not match the key always gives the same `404 RESTAURANT_NOT_FOUND`. Older keys without an environment in the prefix (`lbs_<random>`) are not accepted here; rotate them in LettBestilt Partner.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid or expired API key, and the request does not come from a trusted browser origin. `error.code` is `UNAUTHORIZED`, or `KEY_EXPIRED` when the key is valid but past its expiry date. A partner key (`lbp_…`) always gives `UNAUTHORIZED` here.

InsufficientScope.description: `INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE`: the API key does not have the scope this endpoint needs. `error.details.requiredScope` names it, for example `orders.create`. Create a key with that access in LettBestilt Partner, or use a key with full access.

Address.description: The restaurant's public visiting address. Safe to publish: on the contact page, as `address` and `geo` in Restaurant JSON-LD, and as the map point for pickup. The field is `null` when the restaurant has no street address. It is never an empty shell, so `address === null` means no address to show, not an address with empty fields. `latitude` and `longitude` are both set or both `null`; check one of them before you render a map.

line1.description: Street address, for example "Heggeliveien 5". Never empty.

latitude.description: WGS84. Set when the owner picked the address from the address lookup in the restaurant dashboard.

DayHours.description: One weekday in a set of opening hours. `dayOfWeek` is 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday. Times are local wall-clock time in Europe/Oslo, not UTC. When `isClosed` is `true`, ignore `opensAt` and `closesAt`.

PrepTime.description: The current preparation time, already added up: base time plus rush. Show `pickupMinutes` or `deliveryMinutes` as about X min. They are exactly what `POST /api/v1/orders` uses to set `estimatedReadyAt` (now plus the minutes) on an as-soon-as-possible order. `rushDelayMinutes` above 0 means the kitchen has turned on rush, which turns itself off at the next midnight (Oslo time). Do not calculate anything yourself; show the numbers as they are.

rushDelayMinutes.description: Extra minutes from rush right now (0 = no rush).

basePickupMinutes.description: The restaurant's normal pickup time (same as `defaultPrepMinutes`).

baseDeliveryMinutes.description: The restaurant's normal delivery time (same as `defaultDeliveryMinutes`).

RestaurantCapabilities.description: What the restaurant offers right now, controlled from its dashboard. A stable contract for external restaurant sites: build your UI from this object instead of keeping your own feature flags. Treat a missing or `false` field as not offered.

payment.description: Checkout options. `online` sends the customer to one hosted SagaPay page, where they choose card, Vipps or another enabled method. `cash` is paid at pickup or delivery. In a sandbox, `online` is simulated: the payment page is LettBestilt's test page, and no money moves.

AddressHit.description: An address from Kartverket, with WGS84 coordinates for delivery-zone matching.

postalCode.description: Four-digit postal code. Send it as `deliveryPostalCode`.

Error.description: The error envelope used by every endpoint. Show `error.message` to the customer as it is: it is in Norwegian and written for the customer. Use `error.code` for your own logic.

message.description: A human-readable explanation, often in Norwegian. For business rules it is usually suitable to show the customer.

details.description: Extra data for some codes, for example `issues` for `VALIDATION_FAILED`, the totals for `PRICE_CHANGED` or `requiredScope` for `INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE`.

requestId.description: The same value as the `X-Request-Id` response header. Search for it in the API log in LettBestilt Partner, and include it when you contact LettBestilt.

AddonTier.description: Pricing tier on an addon group. Variants reference a tier via `addonTierKey`; when set, addons in this group use the tier-specific price from `Addon.tierPrices[key]` instead of the base `Addon.price`.

price.description: Base price in øre. Used when the selected variant has no `addonTierKey`, or when no tier override exists.

tierPrices.description: Map of tier `key` → price in øre. If `variant.addonTierKey` matches a key here, use this price instead of `price`. Server re-validates on order create.

AddonGroup.description: A group of add-ons, such as extra toppings. The customer picks between `minSelect` and `maxSelect` of `addons`.

price.description: Absolute price in øre (replaces basePrice when selected).

addonTierKey.description: References an `AddonGroup.tiers[].key`. When set, addons attached to the product use tier-priced overrides for this variant.

ComboSlot.description: Slot in a combo-deal product. The customer must pick between `minQty` and `maxQty` products from `allowedProductIds`. If `requiredTierKey` is set, each chosen variant must have a matching `addonTierKey`.

allowedProductIds.description: Product IDs allowed in this slot. The full products are present elsewhere in the menu response — look them up by ID.

ComboSelection.description: One chosen product for one combo slot. Submit one entry per pick — for `maxQty: 2`, send two entries with the same `slotId`.

productId.description: A product ID from the menu.

variantId.description: The chosen variant, if the product has variants.

notes.description: A note for the kitchen about this line.

categoryId.description: Optional: the id of the menu category the customer picked the product from. A shared product appears in more than one menu, and add-on groups that belong to a category (`scope: CATEGORY`) follow it. When it is one of the categories the product can be ordered from now, its groups apply; otherwise (or when it is left out) the product's own category applies when that menu is in service and the chosen add-ons belong there. Send it for shared products.

comboSelections.description: Required when `productId` refers to a combo product (`isCombo: true`). Total entries per `slotId` must satisfy that slot's `minQty`/`maxQty`. Server re-prices and validates.

Product.description: A product on the menu. Hidden and unavailable products are not included.

nameEn.description: English name, if the restaurant has entered one.

descriptionEn.description: English description, if the restaurant has entered one.

imageIsStock.description: `true` means the image is a generic illustration from LettBestilt's image library, not a photo of the restaurant's own dish. Show «Illustrasjonsfoto» (illustration photo) next to the image when this is `true`.

basePrice.description: The price in øre. A chosen variant's `price` replaces it.

isPopular.description: Marked as popular by the restaurant.

isRecommended.description: Marked as recommended by the restaurant.

isCombo.description: When true, the product is a combo deal. Render the slot wizard from `comboSlots` and send `comboSelections` on order create.

allowedFulfillment.description: `PICKUP` = pickup only, `DELIVERY` = delivery only, `null` = both. The field can be missing in older or cached responses; treat that as `null`. For combo products, the products the customer picks in the slots count too (look them up via `comboSlots`). `POST /api/v1/orders` rejects violations with `422 FULFILLMENT_NOT_ALLOWED`.

allergens.description: Allergen codes. Look them up in the top-level `allergens` list in `GET /api/v1/menu`.

shared.description: `true` when the product lives in another category (often another menu) and is shared into this one. It is the same product with the same `id`, price and availability wherever it is listed, so a cart can use the id from any category. Missing in older or cached responses; treat that as `false`.

homeMenuId.description: The menu the product lives in. Equals the category's `menuId` unless the product is shared from another menu.

MenuSchedule.description: A time window that makes a menu active. `startsAt` and `endsAt` are local wall-clock time in Europe/Oslo.

Menu.description: A menu, such as the main menu or a lunch menu. Only menus that are active right now are returned.

isDefault.description: The fallback menu, used when no other menu is active.

priority.description: Decides which menu wins when several are active at the same time.

schedules.description: When the menu is active. Empty means it is not limited by time of day.

startsOn.description: First valid day (Europe/Oslo), inclusive. `null` means no lower limit.

endsOn.description: Last valid day (Europe/Oslo), inclusive. `null` means no upper limit.

PublicCoupon.description: An offer or coupon, as `GET /api/v1/menu` lists them in `coupons` (code-based) and `promotions` (automatic). The code itself (`code`) is never included: the customer types it, and `POST /api/v1/coupons/validate` decides whether it applies.

displayBadge.description: A short badge text, for example "-20%".

discountType.description: Unknown values: show them as a general offer (more types may be added). `BUNDLE` means X for Y kr.

discountValue.description: `PERCENT`: percent. `FIXED` and `FIXED_PRICE`: øre. `BUNDLE`: the price in øre for one bundle of `bundleQuantity` units, not the discount; show `discount` from validate or preview-auto.

isAutomatic.description: `true` for automatic promotions, `false` for code-based coupons.

allowedDaysOfWeek.description: 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday (Europe/Oslo). An empty list means every day.

allowedFulfillment.description: `PICKUP` or `DELIVERY` if the offer is limited to one of them, otherwise `null`.

bundleQuantity.description: `BUNDLE` only: number of units in one bundle. `null` for other types.

bundleTierKey.description: `BUNDLE` only: only variants with this `addonTierKey` count (for example "stor"). `null` means all sizes.

maxBundlesPerOrder.description: `BUNDLE` only: maximum bundles per order. `null` means no limit.

categories.description: The categories the offer applies to when `appliesTo` is `CATEGORIES`.

products.description: The products the offer applies to when `appliesTo` is `PRODUCTS`.

fulfillment.description: Pickup or delivery. Check `restaurant.capabilities` for what the restaurant offers.

orderType.description: An order is always `TAKEAWAY` (15 % VAT on food). For `DINE_IN` (25 % VAT), use `POST /api/v1/reservations` instead.

customerEmail.description: The order confirmation is sent here.

deliveryPostalCode.description: Four digits. Used to match postal-code delivery zones (`POSTAL_CODES`).

deliveryLat.description: Latitude of the delivery address. Required to match radius-based delivery zones (`RADIUS`); postal-code zones (`POSTAL_CODES`) only need `deliveryPostalCode`. Get it from `GET /api/v1/address-search`.

deliveryLng.description: Longitude of the delivery address. Required to match radius-based delivery zones (`RADIUS`); postal-code zones (`POSTAL_CODES`) only need `deliveryPostalCode`.

deliveryNotes.description: A note for the driver, for example a door code.

pickupNotes.description: A note for the restaurant about the pickup.

requestedPickupAt.description: Optional. The pickup or delivery time for a pre-order (ISO 8601, UTC). Leave it out for as soon as possible. Opening hours, menu schedules and coupon rules are checked against this time.

couponCode.description: A coupon code the customer typed. When a code is sent, automatic promotions are not applied.

expectedTotal.description: Optional. The total in øre you showed the customer. If the server's authoritative total is HIGHER, the order is rejected with `409` and `code: "PRICE_CHANGED"`, and no order is created. A lower total is accepted (the customer pays less than they saw), so an automatic promotion the client cannot reproduce never blocks checkout.

paymentMethod.description: Use `STRIPE` for online payment: `stripeUrl` is SagaPay's hosted payment page, which offers card, Vipps and the other methods the restaurant has enabled. `CASH` is paid at pickup or delivery. `VIPPS` is still accepted for compatibility and also returns the SagaPay page on `stripeUrl`. In a sandbox (test key), `stripeUrl` points to LettBestilt's test page instead of SagaPay, and no money moves.

locale.description: The language of emails to the customer. Defaults to `nb`.

consentGivenAt.description: Optional. When the customer gave marketing consent (ISO 8601).

marketingOptIn.description: The customer's consent to marketing, given at checkout.

attributionCampaignId.description: Campaign attribution: the value of `?lb_campaign=<id>` from a link in the restaurant's newsletter. Pass it on unchanged at checkout, and the order counts as a conversion for the campaign. The tracking script `https://www.lettbestilt.no/sporing/v1.js` remembers the value for 30 days and gives it to you with `LettBestilt.orderFields()`; see [Campaign tracking](https://docs.lettbestilt.no/campaign-tracking). Optional metadata: an invalid or unknown ID is dropped and never blocks the order. The `ORDER_CREATED` and `ORDER_PAID` webhooks show the result in `attributedCampaignId` (`null` when it was dropped).

buyerCompanyName.description: B2B: the company name on the receipt.

buyerOrgNumber.description: B2B: Norwegian organization number, exactly 9 digits (separators are removed by the server).

orderId.description: The order's internal ID. Keep it for support requests, but do not put it in URLs.

publicToken.description: Safe to put in URLs and share with the customer. Use it with `GET /api/v1/orders/{token}`.

totals.description: The authoritative totals, calculated by the server (your own prices are only for display). Show these to the customer before you redirect to payment.

subtotal.description: The sum of all lines including add-ons, in øre.

deliveryFee.description: The delivery fee in øre (0 for pickup).

discount.description: The applied coupon or automatic promotion, in øre.

stripeUrl.description: SagaPay's hosted payment page, for online orders. Redirect the customer here to pay; Vipps is included on this page. The field name is historical and does not identify a provider. In a sandbox (test key) the link points to LettBestilt's test page (`/sandkasse/betaling/{token}`) instead of SagaPay: «Betal (test)» marks the order paid and sends `ORDER_PAID`, «Avbryt» (cancel) sends the customer to `cancelUrl`. No money moves.

vippsUrl.description: No longer returned (direct Vipps was retired). Kept in the schema for compatibility; use `stripeUrl` for online payment.

PartnerRestaurant.description: A restaurant as the partner key alone sees it. No contact details, payment status or customer data.

environment.description: `TEST` for a sandbox, `LIVE` for a real restaurant.

live.description: A real restaurant that has been set live and takes orders. A new real restaurant is not live until the owner has signed, LettBestilt has approved it (QA before go-live; the partner asks for it in LettBestilt Partner, or with `POST /api/v1/partner/restaurants/{slug}/go-live-review` and the MCP tool `request_go_live` with a LIVE partner key, which works once LettBestilt Partner is open) and the owner has set it live. Always `false` for sandboxes; they accept test orders in `/api/v1` anyway.

archived.description: Archived with `DELETE` (real restaurants only). Only LettBestilt can restore it.

nextCursor.description: Send as `cursor` to get the next page. `null` on the last page.

slug.description: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Becomes `{slug}.lettbestilt.no` and the restaurant's identifier in `/api/v1`. Stored in lowercase.

email.description: The restaurant's contact email. For a sandbox, use your own address.

customerPrice.description: Required with a LIVE key (real restaurant), optional with TEST. The price the restaurant pays the partner; it is in the customer agreement the owner signs, and cannot be changed after the owner has signed. Missing for LIVE: `422 VALIDATION_FAILED` with `path: "customerPrice"`.

PartnerCustomerPriceInput.description: The customer price in øre (100 øre = 1 kr), always whole kroner.

startupFeeOere.description: Startup price in øre, whole kroner (divisible by 100).

monthlyFeeOere.description: Monthly price in øre, whole kroner (divisible by 100).

PartnerRestaurantApiKey.description: A restaurant key (`lbs_…`) as the partner sees it. Never the key itself or its hash.

id.description: Used to rotate and revoke the key.

name.description: The name you gave the key.

last4.description: The last four characters of the key.

scopes.description: `["*"]` is full access. Otherwise the scopes the key is limited to.

status.description: `expiring`: the key expires within 14 days and has not been rotated out. `expired` and `revoked` keys no longer work.

expiresAt.description: The expiry date, or `null` for no expiry.

revokedAt.description: When the key was revoked. A time in the future means it still works until then (rotation with a grace period).

lastUsedAt.description: Last use, with a resolution of about 5 minutes.

PartnerNewRestaurantKey.description: A new restaurant key with the plain-text key in `key`, shown ONCE. The same shape on creation and rotation.

key.description: `lbs_test_…` or `lbs_live_…`. Store it now; it is never shown again.

restaurantKey.description: The new restaurant key with full access, in plain text ONCE (`201`). `null` on a replay (`200`): the key is never shown again. If you lost it, create a new key for the restaurant in LettBestilt Partner.

replayed.description: `true` when the response is a replay of the same `Idempotency-Key`.

message.description: On a replay: why the key is missing, and where to create a new one.

PartnerWebhook.description: A webhook subscription. The signing secret is only shown when it is created.

active.description: `false` when the webhook is paused. Events that happen while it is paused are not stored or sent.

pausedReason.description: Added 21.10.2026. Why the webhook is paused, in Norwegian, when it is paused on a real restaurant because its host is not trusted (not a domain verified by a person for the restaurant); a person turns it on in LettBestilt Partner. `null` when the webhook is active, in a sandbox, or paused for another reason. Filled in the webhook list and the restaurant details; in the response to creating a webhook, see `paused` and `pausedReason` next to `data`.

lastDeliveryStatus.description: The HTTP status your endpoint returned on the last delivery.

lastFailureReason.description: A fixed category, for example `HTTP 500` or `request timeout`.

secret.description: The signing secret for the HMAC-SHA256 signature, shown ONCE.

paused.description: Only present when the webhook was created paused (`data.active` is `false`) because the host is not trusted. See `pausedReason`.

pausedReason.description: Only present together with `paused`. Why the webhook is paused, in Norwegian.

PartnerDomain.description: A domain the restaurant's website runs on. A verified domain is accepted for calls from the browser (CORS and browser-origin authentication) and in `successUrl`/`cancelUrl`.

domain.description: The normalised host name (lowercase, ASCII/punycode), for example `www.restauranten.no`.

managedByLettBestilt.description: `true` when LettBestilt manages the domain. It cannot then be removed through the API (`DOMAIN_MANAGED`).

verification.description: The TXT record that proves ownership, while the domain is not verified. `null` once it is verified.

lastCheckedAt.description: The last attempt to verify the domain.

PartnerOwnerInvite.description: A sent owner invitation. It expires after 7 days.

id.description: The invitation's ID. Send it as `inviteId` to `DELETE …/owner-invite`.

PartnerGoLiveCheck.description: One item in the checklist LettBestilt runs before go-live. The text never contains names or email addresses.

level.description: `error` blocks the request; `warning` and `info` do not.

PartnerGoLiveStatus.description: Whether a real restaurant needs approval from LettBestilt before it goes live, and where the request stands. An approval never sets the restaurant live: the owner does that in the onboarding steps.

required.description: `true` for a real restaurant that has never been launched.

state.description: The latest request. An approval is valid for 30 days (`expired` afterwards).

launched.description: The owner has set the restaurant live at least once.

readyToRequest.description: The onboarding steps are done, so `POST …/go-live-review` can be sent.

ownerCanGoLive.description: The owner can set the restaurant live now.

missingSteps.description: The onboarding steps that are not done, as keys. `missingStepDetails` has the same steps with a Norwegian name and what is missing.

missingStepDetails.description: The same steps as `missingSteps`, in the same order, with a Norwegian name (`label`) and what is missing and who does it (`hint`). For example `payment`: the owner must confirm the payment methods in Kom i gang, also when only payment on pickup is on.

comment.description: LettBestilt's comment when the request was rejected.

lastChecks.description: The checklist from the latest request, as ID and level. The texts are in the response to `POST …/go-live-review`.

currentChecks.description: The checklist as it is now, with texts, so you can fix what blocks the request before you send it. Only for a real restaurant that needs approval and has no request waiting or approved; otherwise `null` (also when it was read more than 30 times in a minute). The Brønnøysund Register Centre and the website are only checked when the request is sent (`probed: false`).

PartnerRestaurantDetails.description: Details, available with both keys. No contact details or customer data.

archivedAt.description: When the restaurant was archived, or `null`.

showPoweredBy.description: Added 21.10.2026. Whether the restaurant's website may show "Drevet av LettBestilt" in the footer. The same value as `showPoweredBy` in `GET /api/v1/menu`: `false` when the partner has white label and has turned it off, and the website then never mentions LettBestilt.

confirmedSteps.description: Setup steps the restaurant has confirmed in its onboarding.

launched.description: The owner has set the restaurant live at least once.

payment.description: Online payment with SagaPay. `null` for sandboxes, where payment is simulated.

state.description: `WAITING_FOR_OWNER` (added 20.10.2026): the application is with the owner (registration with BankID, signing or more information). Only the owner can do it. `IN_PROGRESS`: SagaPay is setting up the payment. `FAILED`: the application stopped; the owner can start again. The `PAYMENT_SETUP_UPDATED` webhook is sent when the state changes.

customerPrice.description: The customer price (added 19.10.2026): the price the restaurant pays the partner, in øre. `null` when it is not set. `locked: true` when the owner has signed the customer agreement; the price can then not be changed. The price is changed in LettBestilt Partner.

owner.description: The owner status (added in stage 3). `null` for sandboxes. Never the owner's name or email. `INVITED`/`EXPIRED`: an owner invitation has been sent (`expiresAt`, `null` when it does not expire; `inviteId` can be sent to `DELETE …/owner-invite`). `ACCEPTED`: the owner has access.

inviteId.description: The ID of the open owner invitation (`INVITED`/`EXPIRED`), otherwise `null`.

goLive.description: The go-live status (added in stage 3): the approval from LettBestilt (QA) before a real restaurant goes live for the first time. `null` for sandboxes, which never go live. Never names or email addresses.

domains.description: Verified domains. All domains, including those waiting for verification, are in `GET …/{slug}/domains`.

name.description: The size as it appeared in the PDF, for example «Liten» or «30 cm».

price.description: In øre. The parser always gives a price; `null` is a size that was added in the preview in the restaurant dashboard and has no price yet. Commit rejects `null`.

key.description: A key within the proposal (not a database ID).

number.description: The dish number («12. Pepperoni» → 12). On import the name becomes «12. Pepperoni».

price.description: In øre. `null` when the product has variants (the prices are then on the variants; the first one becomes the default).

allergens.description: Allergen codes from the catalogue (the same as `product.allergens` in `/api/v1/menu`). The restaurant must confirm them.

reasons.description: Why the line is uncertain. `ALCOHOL_SUSPECT` is only a flag.

MenuImportSource.description: Where the proposal came from. `engine: "model"` is the language model, `"parser"` the deterministic parser (fallback). `checkedAgainstText: false` (an image or a scanned PDF) means the prices were NOT checked against text: check every price against the menu before you commit. `fallback` says why the fallback parser was used.

input.description: `pdf_text` (a PDF with a text layer), `pdf_scan` (a scanned PDF) or `image`.

MenuImportProposal.description: The proposal from the parser, including the changes saved from the preview in the restaurant dashboard. Commit only needs the fields in `MenuImportCommitProposal`; you can send this object (edited or not) as it is, and the rest is ignored. At most 60 categories and 800 products. With a text layer, every price and name is checked against the PDF text (`PRICE_NOT_IN_TEXT`, `NAME_NOT_IN_TEXT`); without one, the proposal has the warning `CHECK_AGAINST_MENU`.

ignoredLines.description: Text the parser skipped (headings, address, phone …).

MenuImportCommitProduct.description: The price is either on `price` or on `variants` (the first variant becomes the default). Without variants, `price` must be set.

key.description: Optional. Not used by commit, but validated (1–40 characters).

price.description: In øre. Optional (default `null`) when the product has variants.

key.description: Optional. Not used by commit, but validated (1–40 characters).

products.description: Categories without products are left out.

MenuImportCommitProposal.description: What commit reads. Other fields (`confidence`, `reasons`, `warnings`, `stats` …) are ignored, so the whole `MenuImportProposal` can be sent too. At least one product, at most 60 categories and 800 products.

expiresAt.description: The draft is deleted after 7 days.

isActive.description: The menu is turned off and is not the default menu. For customers to see it, the restaurant must turn it on and make it the default menu (or give it a schedule); turning it on is not enough while another menu is the default.

isDefault.description:
true makes the other default menus non-default in the same transaction, but only when the menu is or becomes active and has no date period (`startsOn` and `endsOn` null). A menu with a date period never takes the default from the main menu (`defaultKept: true` in the response). A menu with a date period (`startsOn`/`endsOn`) is published in one of three ways:

1. **Next to the main menu** in the period: a date period and `isDefault: true`. The main menu stays the default (`defaultKept: true`) and both are shown.
2. **Instead of the main menu** in the period: a date period without `isDefault`, a `priority` higher than the main menu's, and a schedule with all seven days 00:00–23:59 (`PUT …/schedules`). Both are needed: without the schedule the menu is never shown, and when the main menu has a schedule of its own, equal priority shows both and a lower one shows only the main menu.
3. **A new main menu**: `isDefault: true` without a date period. The previous main menu stops being the default.

A menu with a date period but without `isDefault` and without a schedule is never shown while another menu is the default.

sendEmail.description: Also email the owners when the news is published. Default `true`.

restaurantSlugs.description: The recipients as the restaurants' slugs (required when `audienceAll` is false). TEST key: sandboxes only; LIVE key: real restaurants only. A slug that is not one of the partner's restaurants in the key's environment that can be reached now gives `404 RESTAURANT_NOT_FOUND`. LettBestilt Partner calls the field `restaurantIds`; the API rejects that name.

expiresAt.description: Hidden after this day (Oslo time, `YYYY-MM-DD`). `null` = shown until archived.

expectedUpdatedAt.description: `updatedAt` from GET. If the object has changed since, `409 CHANGED` and nothing is written. Without it, nothing is checked.

action.description: Required: an empty body never publishes.

scheduledAt.description: Required for `schedule`; in the future, with a time zone.

restaurants.description: Only for `publish`: the restaurants the news was locked to.

get.description:
Returns the restaurant's public profile: name, branding (logo, colors, font), contact details, visiting address, capabilities, current preparation time and the newsletter popup. Use it for headers, footers and contact pages; it is much smaller than `GET /api/v1/menu`.

- `restaurant.capabilities` is the stable, dashboard-controlled source for pickup, delivery, reservations and payment. The older `restaurant.payment` object is kept for existing clients.
- `restaurant.address` is the restaurant's visiting address, or `null`. See the `Address` schema.
- `restaurant.newsletterPopup` is set when the popup is enabled and linked to an active coupon, otherwise `null`.
- `restaurant.prepTime` includes rush, but this response is cached at the edge (60 s, plus 600 s stale-while-revalidate). Use `GET /api/v1/prep-time` where the number is shown in checkout.
- The raw fields `defaultPrepMinutes` and `defaultDeliveryMinutes` are base times WITHOUT rush and should not be shown directly.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The restaurant's slug, which is also its LettBestilt subdomain (`{slug}.lettbestilt.no`).

200.description: The restaurant, including the stable `capabilities` and, when configured, `newsletterPopup`.

schema.description: Only the fields documented explicitly are listed; the payload contains more (branding, contact details, tracking texts).

400.description: `MISSING_SLUG`: the `slug` query parameter is missing.

404.description: `RESTAURANT_NOT_FOUND`: no restaurant with this slug is available.

get.description:
Returns everything a menu page and checkout need in one call: the restaurant (branding, capabilities, opening hours, special opening hours, delivery zones and shared add-on groups), the active menus, categories with products, variants, add-ons and allergens, code-based coupons, automatic promotions, the allergen list and upsell products.

**Only what is active now.** `menus` and `categories` contain only the menus that are active when the response is built: the validity period (`startsOn`/`endsOn`) first, then the schedules, then the default menu as the fallback. `upsell.products` is filtered the same way.

**Two sets of opening hours.** `restaurant.openingHours` are the KITCHEN's hours and the only set that decides whether an order is accepted: always gate the ordering flow on these. `restaurant.venueHours` are the VENUE's hours (when the doors are open) and are for display only. They are empty when the venue follows the kitchen, and then you show `openingHours`.

**Caching.** `restaurant.prepTime` (base time plus rush) is included, but the response is cached at the edge: show the number from `GET /api/v1/prep-time` in checkout, not from here.

**Address.** `restaurant.address` is the restaurant's visiting address, or `null`: the same object `GET /api/v1/restaurant` returns. Use it on the contact page and for `address` and `geo` in Restaurant JSON-LD. See the `Address` schema.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The restaurant's slug, which is also its LettBestilt subdomain (`{slug}.lettbestilt.no`).

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: The `ETag` from an earlier response. If the menu has not changed, the response is `304 Not Modified` with no body.

200.description: The menu, with a weak `ETag` and `Cache-Control` headers.

schema.description: Only the fields documented explicitly are listed; the payload contains the whole menu, coupons, opening hours and delivery zones.

openingHours.description: The KITCHEN's opening hours. The only set that gates ordering: the server rejects an order outside these hours.

venueHours.description: The VENUE's opening hours (when the doors are open). Display ONLY: never use them to decide whether ordering is possible. An empty array means the venue follows the kitchen; show `openingHours` instead.

showPoweredBy.description: Show "Drevet av LettBestilt" in the footer only when `showPoweredBy` is true. It is false when the partner has turned it off (white label); the website then never mentions LettBestilt.

menus.description: Only menus that are active when the response is built (validity period → schedule → default menu as fallback). The response is cached at the edge (CDN), so also hide a menu on the client when today's date in Oslo is before `startsOn` or after `endsOn`. A missing field means no limit.

categories.description: Top-level categories on the active menus, with their products.

coupons.description: Code-based coupons, without the code itself. The customer types the code; `POST /api/v1/coupons/validate` checks it.

promotions.description: Automatic promotions. Show them as banners; the server applies them in checkout.

upsell.description: Products the restaurant wants to suggest in the cart, or `null` if upsell is not set up.

products.description: Only active, available products on menus that are active now (since October 2026; before that, products on inactive menus were also returned).

404.description: `RESTAURANT_NOT_FOUND`: no restaurant with this slug is available.

Use the coordinates as `deliveryLat` and `deliveryLng` for radius-based delivery zones (`RADIUS`), and the postal code as `deliveryPostalCode` for postal-code zones (`POSTAL_CODES`). If the restaurant does not offer delivery, `hits` is empty.

post.description:
Creates a takeaway order (15 % VAT) for pickup or delivery. The server prices every line from its own data and ignores any prices you send. Show the `totals` it returns.

- **Online payment** (`paymentMethod: "STRIPE"`): the response includes `stripeUrl`, SagaPay's hosted payment page. Redirect the customer there. The field name is historical and does not mean Stripe.
- **Cash** (`paymentMethod: "CASH"`): there is no payment link, and the order goes straight to the kitchen.
- **Sandbox** (test key on a sandbox restaurant): `stripeUrl` points to LettBestilt's test payment page instead of SagaPay. No money moves. See [Payments](https://docs.lettbestilt.no/payments#testing-payments-in-a-sandbox).
- **Retries**: send an `Idempotency-Key` header and retry with the same key after a network error. A replay returns the original order instead of creating a new one.
- **Price check**: send `expectedTotal`, the total you showed the customer, to get `409 PRICE_CHANGED` instead of an order at a higher price.

Business rules are checked here as well. Branch on `error.code`; `error.message` explains the problem in Norwegian and can be shown to the customer.
- **What the restaurant offers** (`400`): `PAYMENT_METHOD_DISABLED` (the owner has turned off that payment method), `ONLINE_PAYMENT_UNAVAILABLE` (card or Vipps, but the restaurant has no active SagaPay yet, so only cash works), `DELIVERY_DISABLED` and `PICKUP_DISABLED`. Read `restaurant.capabilities` from `GET /api/v1/restaurant` and offer only what is `true` to avoid them.
- **Opening hours** (`400 BAD_REQUEST`): the restaurant is closed now, or at `requestedPickupAt`.
- **The cart** (`422`): a product, size (variant) or add-on that no longer exists, is turned off, is sold out or is outside its menu's schedule gives `PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE` (fetch the menu again); required add-ons, delivery zone and minimum order, and coupon rules give `VALIDATION_FAILED` without `details`; a product that cannot be ordered with the chosen fulfillment gives `FULFILLMENT_NOT_ALLOWED`.
- **The payment provider** (`503 PAYMENT_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE`): SagaPay did not answer when the payment link was being created. The order was created but is `FAILED` and cannot be paid, and a coupon it used is released. Start again with a new `Idempotency-Key`, or offer cash; a retry with the same key returns `409 PAYMENT_INCOMPLETE`. Never happens in a sandbox.

`DINE_IN` is not accepted here: table reservations go through `POST /api/v1/reservations` as a request. `orderType` is locked to `TAKEAWAY` in the validation schema, so sending `orderType: "DINE_IN"` is rejected as `422 VALIDATION_FAILED` (not a separate DINE_IN-specific error code). Walkthrough: [Build an ordering flow](https://docs.lettbestilt.no/build-an-ordering-flow).

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The restaurant's slug, which is also its LettBestilt subdomain (`{slug}.lettbestilt.no`).

parameters.name: successUrl
parameters.description: Where the customer returns after paying. Put `{TOKEN}` in the URL as a placeholder for `publicToken`, for example `https://www.pizzaroma.no/order/{TOKEN}`. Must be `https` on lettbestilt.no (or a subdomain), on a verified domain of the restaurant or its partner, or on a domain LettBestilt has approved manually; otherwise `400 INVALID_SUCCESS_URL`. Partners add and verify a new host themselves on the restaurant's Domains tab in LettBestilt Partner, or with `POST /api/v1/partner/restaurants/{slug}/domains`. A sandbox also accepts `http` or `https` to `localhost`, `127.0.0.1` and `[::1]` on any port, and `https` to `*.vercel.app`, so you can test the return from your own machine or a preview deployment; a real restaurant does not. A URL with a user name or password in it is always rejected. In a sandbox you can leave it out: without `successUrl` the customer returns to the test page, which shows that the order is paid.

parameters.name: cancelUrl
parameters.description: Where the customer returns if the payment is cancelled. Must be `https` on lettbestilt.no (or a subdomain), on a verified domain of the restaurant or its partner, or on a domain LettBestilt has approved manually; otherwise `400 INVALID_CANCEL_URL`. Partners add and verify a new host themselves on the restaurant's Domains tab in LettBestilt Partner, or with `POST /api/v1/partner/restaurants/{slug}/domains`. A sandbox also accepts the same development hosts as `successUrl` (`localhost`, `127.0.0.1` and `[::1]` on any port, and `https` to `*.vercel.app`); a real restaurant does not. In a sandbox you can leave it out: without `cancelUrl` the customer returns to the test page, which shows that the payment was cancelled.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional. 16–128 URL-safe characters (`a-z`, `A-Z`, `0-9`, `_`, `-`); a UUID works well. A request with a key already used for this restaurant returns that existing order instead of creating a new one.

200.description: The order was created, or an earlier order was returned for the same `Idempotency-Key`.

400.description: The request or the restaurant's setup rules out the order. No order was created. `MISSING_SLUG`: the `slug` query parameter is missing. `INVALID_JSON`: the body is not JSON. `INVALID_SUCCESS_URL` / `INVALID_CANCEL_URL`: the return URL is not on an accepted host (see the parameters). `PAYMENT_METHOD_DISABLED`: the owner has turned off the chosen `paymentMethod` (cash, or card and Vipps). `ONLINE_PAYMENT_UNAVAILABLE`: `STRIPE` or `VIPPS`, but the restaurant has no active SagaPay yet, so there is no online payment; offer cash. `DELIVERY_DISABLED` / `PICKUP_DISABLED`: the restaurant does not offer that `fulfillment`. `BAD_REQUEST`: the restaurant is closed now or at `requestedPickupAt`, or the `Idempotency-Key` header is not 16–128 URL-safe characters.

401.description: `UNAUTHORIZED`: missing or invalid API key, and the request does not come from a trusted browser origin. `KEY_EXPIRED`: the API key is valid but past its expiry date.

404.description: `RESTAURANT_NOT_FOUND`: no live restaurant or active sandbox has this `slug`.

409.description: Conflict: no new order was created, and `publicToken` is never returned in these errors. `PRICE_CHANGED`: you sent `expectedTotal` and the server's authoritative total is higher (`error.details: { expectedTotal, actualTotal, currency }`); fetch the prices again and retry. `PAYMENT_PENDING`: a replay of an `Idempotency-Key` whose order was just created while its payment link is still being made; wait a couple of seconds and retry with the SAME key. `PAYMENT_INCOMPLETE`: a replay of an `Idempotency-Key` whose order has no payment link and never will: the order is too old for the first call to still be running, or the payment provider failed when it was created (`error.details: { orderId }`); start the order again with a new key. `IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT`: the `Idempotency-Key` was already used by a table reservation (`POST /reservations`); orders and reservations share one key space per restaurant, so create a new key.

422.description: `PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE`: a product, size (variant) or add-on in the cart no longer exists, is turned off, is sold out or is outside its menu's schedule (no `details`; `error.message` names it in Norwegian and can be shown to the customer). Fetch the menu again and let the customer adjust the cart. Before October 2026 this was `VALIDATION_FAILED`. `VALIDATION_FAILED`: the body failed validation (`error.details.issues`), or the cart breaks a business rule: a required add-on, the delivery zone or minimum order, or a coupon rule (no `details`; `error.message` explains it in Norwegian). `FULFILLMENT_NOT_ALLOWED`: a product cannot be ordered with the chosen fulfillment (`error.details: { productId, productName, allowedFulfillment, requestedFulfillment }`).

429.description: `RATE_LIMITED`: too many requests. Try again shortly.

502.description: `PAYMENT_PROVIDER_INVALID`: the payment provider returned a payment link that is not `https` (or contains credentials), so it is not passed on. The order exists but the customer cannot pay it; start again with a new `Idempotency-Key`.

503.description: `PAYMENT_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE`: SagaPay did not answer when the payment link was being created. The order was created but is `FAILED` and cannot be paid, and a coupon it used is released. Start again with a new `Idempotency-Key`, or offer cash; a retry with the same key returns `409 PAYMENT_INCOMPLETE`. Never happens in a sandbox.

get.description:
Returns an order by its `publicToken`: status, lines, totals, times and payment status. No API key is needed, because the token is the secret. Share it only with the customer.

`order.restaurant.address` is the pickup location: the restaurant's visiting address, or `null`, the same object `GET /api/v1/menu` returns. If you render a map, gate it on `order.restaurant.trackingShowMap` AND on `address.latitude` being present: the owner can turn the map off, and a restaurant without a map point has no coordinates to show. `payment.provider` is `SANDBOX` for test payments in a sandbox; treat unknown values as online payment.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The `publicToken` from `POST /api/v1/orders` or `POST /api/v1/reservations`.

schema.description: Only the fields documented explicitly are listed; the payload contains the whole order, its lines and the payment status.

requestedPickupAt.description: The AGREED pickup or delivery time, and the time to show the customer. The restaurant can move it after the order is placed: if `pickupTimeRevisedAt` is set, this is no longer the time the customer originally chose.

originalRequestedPickupAt.description: The time the customer originally chose, frozen the first time it is moved. `null` means the time has never been moved.

pickupTimeRevisedAt.description: When the restaurant last moved the pickup or delivery time: either the agreed time on a pre-order (`requestedPickupAt`) or, during rush, the estimated ready time on an as-soon-as-possible order (`estimatedReadyAt`; then `originalRequestedPickupAt` is `null`). Use it to show that the restaurant has changed the time instead of changing the time silently. `null` means never moved.

trackingShowMap.description: The owner's setting for whether the tracking page shows a map to the pickup location.

404.description: `ORDER_NOT_FOUND`: no order has this token.

get.description: Returns a list of 15-minute slots for the chosen date and party size. `available: true` means at least one table fits. Slots outside opening hours or too late in the day (after `closesAt − serviceMinutes`) are not included. If the restaurant does not have table reservations enabled, the response has `enabled: false`. Rate limit: 60 per 60 seconds per (slug, IP). Cache: `s-maxage=15, stale-while-revalidate=30`. Walkthrough: [Table reservations](https://docs.lettbestilt.no/reservations).

maxPartySize.description: The largest party that can book online. Only present when `enabled` is `true`.

available.description: Whether a table is free for the party at this time.

401.description: `UNAUTHORIZED`: missing or invalid API key, and the request does not come from a trusted browser origin. `KEY_EXPIRED`: the API key is valid but past its expiry date.

404.description: `RESTAURANT_NOT_FOUND`: no restaurant with this slug is available.

429.description: `RATE_LIMITED`: too many requests. Try again shortly.

get.description:
Returns the current preparation time: base time plus rush, already added up. This is what the restaurant's website should show as about X min on the menu and in checkout.

It is a separate endpoint because `/restaurant` and `/menu` are cached at the edge for up to 5–11 minutes, and rush is exactly when that delay hurts. This response is `no-store`. Cache it yourself for 20–30 seconds, and fetch it again when checkout opens.

Same authentication as the rest of the API (API key or trusted browser origin), so you can call it from the browser on a verified domain. Rate limit: 600 per 60 seconds per (slug, IP).

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The restaurant's slug, which is also its LettBestilt subdomain (`{slug}.lettbestilt.no`).

400.description: `MISSING_SLUG`: the `slug` query parameter is missing.

401.description: `UNAUTHORIZED`: missing or invalid API key, and the request does not come from a trusted browser origin. `KEY_EXPIRED`: the API key is valid but past its expiry date.

404.description: `RESTAURANT_NOT_FOUND`: no restaurant with this slug is available.

429.description: `RATE_LIMITED`: more than 600 requests in 60 seconds for this slug and IP.

get.description:
Tells the restaurant's own website whether its preview password gate should be on, and which password applies. Meant to be called from the website's middleware or server, so the gate can be turned off from LettBestilt admin without a redeploy.

**Requires an API key.** Unlike the rest of `/api/v1`, origin-based browser authentication is NOT accepted here: the response carries a password and must never be readable from a browser. `password` is only returned when `enabled` is `true`. The response is never cached (`no-store`), so turning the gate off takes effect at once.

The slug lookup deliberately does not filter on `isActive`: a restaurant that is not live yet is exactly the one that needs the gate.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The restaurant's slug, which is also its LettBestilt subdomain (`{slug}.lettbestilt.no`).

password.description: Only present when `enabled` is `true`. `null` means the gate is on but no password is set; the website should then fail closed.

401.description: `UNAUTHORIZED`: missing or invalid API key, or the call came from a browser origin instead of with an API key. `KEY_EXPIRED`: the API key is valid but past its expiry date.

404.description: `RESTAURANT_NOT_FOUND`: no restaurant with this slug is available.

post.description: Creates a table reservation REQUEST. The restaurant approves or rejects it from its dashboard, and the guest gets an email when the status changes. Returns `status: "PENDING_APPROVAL"` and `tableId: null`; a table is only assigned on approval. Use `publicToken` to check the status with `GET /api/v1/orders/{token}`. Rate limit: 20 per 60 seconds per (slug, IP), more lenient than `/api/v1/orders` (10 per 60 seconds) because a reservation request is low-stakes and approved by staff. `Idempotency-Key` (16–128 URL-safe characters) is supported. Walkthrough: [Table reservations](https://docs.lettbestilt.no/reservations).

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The restaurant's slug, which is also its LettBestilt subdomain (`{slug}.lettbestilt.no`).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional. 16–128 URL-safe characters (`a-z`, `A-Z`, `0-9`, `_`, `-`).

guestEmail.description: Strongly recommended: without it, the guest cannot be told when the request is approved or rejected.

note.description: A note to the restaurant, for example about allergies or a high chair.

marketingOptIn.description: Consent to marketing. Requires `guestEmail`; the consent is stored in the restaurant's subscriber list.

consentGivenAt.description: Optional documented time of consent. Requires `marketingOptIn: true`; otherwise the server uses the time it received the request.

locale.description: Language of the emails to the guest.

attributedCampaignId.description: Campaign attribution: the value of `?lb_campaign=<id>` from a LettBestilt campaign link. The reservation counts as a campaign conversion. Optional metadata: an invalid or unknown ID is dropped silently and never blocks the reservation. Note that orders call this field `attributionCampaignId`.

reservationId.description: The reservation's ID. Webhooks call it `orderId`.

publicToken.description: Use it with `GET /api/v1/orders/{token}` to follow the status.

orderNumber.description: The number the restaurant sees in its dashboard.

tableId.description: Always `null` when the request is created. Assigned when the restaurant approves it.

401.description: `UNAUTHORIZED`: missing or invalid API key, and the request does not come from a trusted browser origin. `KEY_EXPIRED`: the API key is valid but past its expiry date.

409.description: Either `IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT` in the standard error envelope (the same key was used with a different body or by an order), or `ONLINE_BOOKING_CLOSED` in the older, flat error shape (`{ "error": "…", "code": "ONLINE_BOOKING_CLOSED" }`) when the restaurant has closed online booking.

422.description: `VALIDATION_FAILED`, `DINE_IN_DISABLED` (the restaurant does not take reservations), `TOO_EARLY` (inside the restaurant's minimum notice) or `PARTY_TOO_LARGE`.

429.description: `RATE_LIMITED`: too many requests. Try again shortly.

post.description:
Adds the customer to the restaurant's newsletter and returns the welcome coupon. Idempotent on (restaurant, email): signing up again returns the same coupon.

The newsletter popup must be enabled in the restaurant's dashboard and linked to an active coupon; otherwise the response is `404`. Check `restaurant.newsletterPopup` in `GET /api/v1/restaurant` before you show a signup form.

Rate limit: 5 per 60 seconds per IP.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The restaurant's slug, which is also its LettBestilt subdomain (`{slug}.lettbestilt.no`).

200.description: The customer is subscribed and the welcome coupon is issued.

couponCode.description: The welcome code. Show it to the customer.

discountType.description: The kind of discount the code gives.

successMessage.description: The restaurant's thank-you text. Replace `{{code}}` and `{{discount}}` before you show it.

401.description: `UNAUTHORIZED`: missing or invalid API key, and the request does not come from a trusted browser origin. `KEY_EXPIRED`: the API key is valid but past its expiry date.

404.description: `RESTAURANT_NOT_FOUND`, or `POPUP_NOT_AVAILABLE` when the popup is turned off or has no active coupon.

422.description: `VALIDATION_FAILED`: the body failed validation.

429.description: `RATE_LIMITED`: too many requests. Try again shortly.

post.description:
Returns the discount the server would apply when the order is created, if no coupon code is used. Use it to show a line such as «Tilbud: −X kr» (offer) in your cart summary. The server evaluates promotions again in `POST /api/v1/orders`, so this is for display only.

If no automatic promotion matches, the response is `{ "applies": false, "discount": 0 }`. For this endpoint, `slug` goes in the **body**. Guide: [Coupons and promotions](https://docs.lettbestilt.no/coupons).

slug.description: The restaurant's slug. Sent in the body for this endpoint.

fulfillment.description: `PICKUP` or `DELIVERY`. Send it so promotions limited to one of them are evaluated correctly.

deliveryFee.description: The delivery fee in øre. Needed for free-delivery promotions.

requestedPickupAt.description: Optional. The pickup time the customer selected for a pre-order (same value you send as `requestedPickupAt` to `POST /api/v1/orders`). Day-of-week and time-of-day restrictions on the coupon (and its expiry) are evaluated against THIS moment, not the moment of the request — a Monday/Tuesday offer must not apply to an order placed on Tuesday for a Thursday pickup. Omit for as-soon-as-possible orders. Send the same value here and on the order, or the cart will show a discount the order rejects.

categoryId.description: Optional. If omitted the server resolves it from productId — convenient for clients that don't track categoryId on each line.

quantity.description: Number of units on the line. Counts units for `BUNDLE` offers (X for Y kr).

variantName.description: Required for `FIXED_PRICE` promotions with per-variant prices (for example `Medium` or `Stor`). Also used for `BUNDLE` offers limited to one size.

lineTotal.description: Unit price × quantity in øre, incl. addons.

200.description: The best matching automatic promotion, or `applies: false` and `discount: 0` when none matches.

discountType.description: Unknown values: show them as a general offer.

discountValue.description: `PERCENT`: percent. `FIXED` and `FIXED_PRICE`: øre. `BUNDLE`: the price in øre for one bundle of `bundleQuantity` units, not the discount; show `discount`.

bundleTierKey.description: `BUNDLE` only: only variants with this `addonTierKey` count.

maxBundlesPerOrder.description: `BUNDLE` only: the maximum number of bundles per order.

401.description: `UNAUTHORIZED`: authentication failed. `KEY_EXPIRED`: the API key is valid but past its expiry date.

404.description: `RESTAURANT_NOT_FOUND`: no restaurant with this slug is available.

422.description: `VALIDATION_FAILED`: the body failed validation.

429.description: `RATE_LIMITED`: too many requests. Try again shortly.

post.description:
Checks a code the customer typed against the cart, so you can show the discount before checkout. A well-formed request always gets `200`: read `valid`, and `reason` when it is `false`.

The discount is calculated again when the order is created; send the code as `couponCode` to `POST /api/v1/orders`. For this endpoint, `slug` goes in the **body**. Guide: [Coupons and promotions](https://docs.lettbestilt.no/coupons).

slug.description: The restaurant's slug. Sent in the body for this endpoint.

subtotal.description: The cart subtotal in øre, including add-ons.

fulfillment.description: Optional. Pass to evaluate `WRONG_FULFILLMENT` correctly when the coupon is restricted to one fulfillment type.

deliveryFee.description: Optional. The delivery fee in øre, needed to evaluate `FREE_DELIVERY` coupons correctly.

cart.description: Optional for validate (unlike preview-auto, where it's required). Pass it when the coupon is scoped to specific products/categories, uses per-variant FIXED_PRICE pricing, or is a BUNDLE («X for Y kr») offer, so `NOT_APPLICABLE_TO_CART` can be evaluated correctly. **Partner key + restaurant key.** `multipart/form-data` with the menu in the field `file`: a PDF (up to 4 MB and 20 pages) or a JPEG, PNG or WebP image (up to 4 MB, 200 to 8000 pixels per side; HEIC is not supported). patch.description:
**Partner key + restaurant key.** The only call that puts a menu in service. `{ "isActive": true, "isDefault": true }` makes it the main menu, and the previous default menu stops being the default in the same transaction, but only when the menu is or becomes active and has no date period. `{ "isActive": false }` takes it out of service. Omitted fields are unchanged. `priority` (0–100) decides which menu is shown when several have a schedule window at the same time: the highest wins, and with equal priority all are shown. Reordering the menus in the restaurant dashboard rewrites it (top is highest).

A menu with a date period (`startsOn`/`endsOn`) is published in one of three ways:

1. **Next to the main menu** in the period: a date period and `isDefault: true`. The main menu stays the default (`defaultKept: true`) and both are shown.
2. **Instead of the main menu** in the period: a date period without `isDefault`, a `priority` higher than the main menu's, and a schedule with all seven days 00:00–23:59 (`PUT …/schedules`). Both are needed: without the schedule the menu is never shown, and when the main menu has a schedule of its own, equal priority shows both and a lower one shows only the main menu.
3. **A new main menu**: `isDefault: true` without a date period. The previous main menu stops being the default.

A menu with a date period but without `isDefault` and without a schedule is never shown while another menu is the default.

`warnings` says when no menu is visible afterwards, or when another menu becomes visible. `name` is cleaned like category names (`textCleaned` in the response). Menus have no `updatedAt`: a change that collides with a concurrent change gives 409 `CHANGED`. `GET /api/v1/menu` is CDN-cached (`s-maxage=30, stale-while-revalidate=300`, at most 330 seconds), so the website can show the old menu for up to six minutes. Among the active menus inside their date period: when one or more have a schedule window right now, only those are shown (the highest `priority`; equal priority shows all), also instead of the default menu. Otherwise the default menu is shown, also when it has a schedule of its own and is outside it. A menu with a schedule that is not the default is therefore shown only inside its windows, and the main menu must be the default to be shown the rest of the time. With no active default menu, all active menus are shown outside the windows. `isLiveNow` says whether the menu is shown right now. The response has `notice` with this when the change puts the menu in or out of service, and the CDN text for any other change to an active menu.

patch.description:
**Partner key only.** Changes the fields you send, with the same rules as Brand in LettBestilt Partner; a field you leave out stays as it is, and `null` clears it. With `expectedUpdatedAt` (the `updatedAt` you read), nothing is written if the partner changed in the meantime (`409 CHANGED`).

Colours are hex with a contrast of at least 4.5:1. Through LettBestilt MCP, `websiteUrl` gives `403 HUMAN_REQUIRED` (the restaurant owners see the website as a link, so a person sets it; it does not make a webhook host trusted). Through MCP, `logoUrl` and `logoLightUrl` can only reuse a file you already have on LettBestilt's upload host (your current logo or light logo, or a logo you uploaded yourselves); any other address gives `422 LOGO_NOT_ALLOWED`, and `null` or an empty value gives `403 HUMAN_REQUIRED` (MCP never removes the logos). LettBestilt never downloads images from other addresses. Logged with the field names.

400.description: `INVALID_JSON`: the body is not valid JSON.

401.description: `UNAUTHORIZED`: the partner key is missing, invalid or revoked, or the partner is suspended or archived. `KEY_EXPIRED`: the key is past its expiry date.

403.description: `KEY_ROLE_FORBIDDEN`: the person who created the key no longer has the Partner or Administrator role in the partner team (`error.details.capability` is `news.manage`). `PARTNER_NEWS_FORBIDDEN`: only external partners have news. `HUMAN_REQUIRED`: `publish` or `schedule` through LettBestilt MCP with a LIVE key (news to real restaurants is published by a person; `unschedule` is allowed). Or as for reading: `FORBIDDEN` (`Origin` header), `PARTNER_AGREEMENT_REQUIRED` or `PARTNER_NOT_APPROVED`.

404.description: `NEWS_NOT_FOUND`: the same response for an unknown id, another partner's news and news outside the key's environment.

409.description: `NOT_DRAFT` (schedule), `NOT_SCHEDULED` (unschedule), `NOT_PUBLISHED` (archive), `NOT_CLAIMABLE` (already published or archived) or `PARTNER_ARCHIVED`.

422.description: `NO_RECIPIENTS`: none of the recipients can be reached now. `VALIDATION_FAILED`: `action` missing or unknown, an unknown field, or `scheduledAt` missing or in the past.

429.description: `RATE_LIMITED`: 30 changes per minute, 60 per 10 minutes, or 10 sends per day.
